get.description: Ready once the bundle is loaded and Redis and the database answer.

Open cases, highest expected savings first, by default. Filter by `status`
(`all` for every case) and `assignee`; paginate with `limit` / `offset`.

post.description:
Closes the case and stores the verdict as an `analyst` label (unless the
transaction already had a label, e.g. a chargeback).

`{txn_id, observed_fraud, step}`: the replayer posts these `L` steps after the
transaction. Posting the same txn_id again changes nothing (200).

Each label is handled as by `POST /v1/labels` (first label wins, confirmed
fraud feeds the feature state), in one database round trip. Unknown transactions
and labels dated before their transaction are listed and skipped.
